periods.time: Caldia battle, after relay-node operation begins succeeding

name.zh: B·B巨人化袭击与一辉诱导
name.en: B.B. giant attack and Ikki's lure

periods.location: Caldia central avenue and railway crossing
periods.summary: B.B. appears as a thirty-meter giant, crushes the helicopter carrying Ikki and Milialia, and devastates the central avenue by throwing road slabs. Ikki escapes with Milialia and the pilot, then despite depleted magic blinds B.B. in one eye and lets himself be knocked toward a railway crossing to lure the giant away from unconscious soldiers. B.B. touches high-voltage wires but grows to over three hundred meters and nearly stomps Ikki; Alice Ascaride arrives, endures the stomp through Unbreakable, cuts B.B.'s foot, and drives him away by scolding him like a child.
periods.cause: Or-Gaule's faction needs to disrupt Ikki's aerial spotting and the successful nonlethal rescue plan.
periods.process: B.B. crushes the helicopter, but Ikki pulls the passengers out and Timid catches them with Starry Sea. B.B.'s thrown debris kills soldiers, so Ikki uses a fire hydrant water jet as footing and Saigeki to pierce B.B.'s eye, drawing his anger. Ikki survives being swatted away and places himself near high-voltage wires, but the trap only triggers further giantification. Alice intervenes at the last moment, regenerating through crushing force and then exploiting B.B.'s child mentality.
periods.outcome: B.B. flees crying, the central avenue avoids further immediate massacre, and Ikki survives but is badly injured. Alice's role as a top-tier Desperado ally is proven.
periods.significance: Interrupts the rescue operation, demonstrates Or-Gaule faction's destructive power, and reveals B.B.'s true five-year-old mentality.
